title: Machine learning and burden analyses highlight novel candidate genes in Parkinson’s disease
authors: Parlar SC; Yu E; Kanagasingam S; Zhang Z; Liu L; Shahkhali MG; Chantereault C; Karpilovsky N; Worrall D; Thomas RA; Senkevich K; Fon EA; Gan-Or Z
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习整合多组学特征进行帕金森病风险基因优先排序并结合罕见变异负荷分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous risk loci for Parkinson’s disease, yet identifying specific causal genes remains a major challenge due to non-coding associations and complex linkage disequilibrium. Here, we present a systematic framework integrating machine learning-based gene prioritization with high-resolution rare variant burden analysis. Using an XGBoost machine-learning model trained on 285 multi-omic features, including brain-specific eQTLs and single-cell expression, we prioritized 406 out of 3,105 genes across 147 risk loci. The list of prioritized genes underwent gene- and domain-level rare variant burden analysis via optimal sequenced kernel association test (SKAT-O) across the Accelerating Medicines Partnership for Parkinson’s Disease and UK Biobank cohorts (N case = 6,435, N proxy = 13,889, N control = 343,160). Meta-analysis of rare variants at the gene and domain levels replicated established associations ( GBA1 , LRRK2 ) and identified six novel potential risk genes ANKRD27 driven by p.Arg21Cys, UBXN2A , FAM171A1 , ERCC8 , BNC2 , and ADNP . Domain-level analysis uniquely uncovered a significant association in the zinc-finger domain of ADNP , which was masked in gene-level tests. Additionally, at cohort-level, one novel gene was nominated: LRRC45 driven by p.Met607ArgfsTer57. Collectively, our results indicate that integrating machine-learning prioritization with gene- and domain-level burden testing identifies novel genes potentially involved in Parkinson’s disease, with further validation needed to elucidate causality and mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已识别出众多帕金森病的风险位点，然而，由于非编码关联和复杂的连锁不平衡，识别特定因果基因仍是一项重大挑战。在此，我们提出一个系统框架，将基于机器学习的基因优先级排序与高分辨率罕见变异负荷分析相结合。利用在285个多组学特征（包括脑特异性eQTL和单细胞表达）上训练的XGBoost机器学习模型，我们在147个风险位点中的3,105个基因中优先排序了406个基因。优先排序的基因列表通过最优序列核关联检验（SKAT-O）在帕金森病加速医学伙伴关系和英国生物库队列（病例数N = 6,435，代理病例数N = 13,889，对照数N = 343,160）中进行了基因水平和结构域水平的罕见变异负荷分析。基因和结构域水平的罕见变异荟萃分析复现了已确立的关联（GBA1、LRRK2），并识别出六个新的潜在风险基因：ANKRD27（由p.Arg21Cys驱动）、UBXN2A、FAM171A1、ERCC8、BNC2和ADNP。结构域水平分析独特地揭示了ADNP锌指结构域中的显著关联，而这一关联在基因水平检验中被掩盖。此外，在队列水平上，提名了一个新基因：LRRC45（由p.Met607ArgfsTer57驱动）。总体而言，我们的结果表明，将机器学习优先级排序与基因和结构域水平负荷检验相结合，可识别出可能参与帕金森病的新基因，但需进一步验证以阐明因果关系和机制。
